_FINDING: 2026-08-28 (C), after fixing the probe: register IS in z, LINEARLY, and the nonlinear gain is small -- lin 0.511 vs mlp+ctx2 0.561 corr (+0.05), MAE 6.74 -> 6.38 st. So a SIMPLE readout captures nearly all of it and ~0.56 is the substrate ceiling, not a modelling limit. But MAE ~6.4 st is half an octave: z carries the melodic REGISTER CONTOUR (is the lead high or low just now), NOT note-accurate pitch. CAUTION on pitchclass_mae_st ~3.0: that is EXACTLY chance for a circular 12-class quantity (mean |error| of a uniform draw = 3.0), but it is DERIVED from the coarse height estimate (height mod 12), NOT an independent chroma readout -- it is NOT evidence that chroma is absent from z. The same_chroma LatCH head reads a 384-d chroma directly and works. IMPLICATION: an f0 LatCH is viable as a CONTOUR/REGISTER control, not a note-level one -- which is what the existing melody_contour riffers already target with vocabs 5/9/15/77 (coarse contour alphabets). That convergence suggests whoever sized those vocabularies chose well.
